summary: Learn to check community programme records, analyse indicators in Excel, and report findings responsibly. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Community data analytics uses community and programme records to assess activities and outcomes. This foundation-level course is for monitoring and evaluation staff, programme coordinators, field supervisors and community researchers who need to explain programme evidence. In Excel exercises, you’ll define indicators, review record quality, calculate descriptive measures, interpret disaggregated results cautiously, and draft findings summaries with community feedback questions and stewardship checks.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits people who collect, review, analyse, or explain community programme evidence and need a practical way to make their findings more usable and responsible.
prerequisites: No prior analytics qualification or coding experience is required. Familiarity with community programme records is helpful.
